name: FUN_WF_HISTORY
description: FUN_WF_HISTORY contains the approval and rejection history of each submission that passes through the Approval Workflow process. This table is for capturing the high level transaction history and submission details.

columns.name: HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier that correlates the table FUN_WF_HISTORY with the table FUN_WF_HISTORY_LINES.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Transaction undergoing the approval cycle.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference identifier to the FUN_WORKFLOWS_B table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Unique application identification number.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the approval workflow transaction.

columns.name: INITIATION_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of transaction initiation.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_BY
columns.description: Name of the transaction submitter.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Current status of the transaction. Once approval is completed,This field will indicate final status of the transaction.Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_FUN_APPROVAL_STATUS.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_OUTCOME_CODE
columns.description: Current workflow outcome of the transaction. Once approval is completed, this field will indicate final workflow outcome of the transaction.This field will indicate final status of the transaction.Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_FUN_APPROVAL_WF_OUTCOME.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction creation source. Possible values are manually, batch, and so on.Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_FUN_APPROVAL_TXN_SOURCE.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Process ID which submitted the transaction. When transaction is submitted through automated process like an ESS job, this field stores the request ID.

columns.name: LAST_ACTED_BY
columns.description: User who last acted on the transaction.

columns.name: FLOW_ID
columns.description: Flow identifier of the submission.

columns.name: TAC_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for Transaction Console.

columns.name: ROOT_TASK_ID
columns.description: Root task identifier of the submission.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT
columns.description: Additional detailed meta data for transaction.

columns.name: COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of the transaction approval completion.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
